title: E1 agent output (e1-type-tagger)
description: Spec 13/E1 'Agent output': {"question_type","new_description","confidence"} -- matching .claude/agents/e1-type-tagger.md's worked example exactly, the same convention as every other agent-output schema in this build (schemas/B7.json, schemas/D4.json). THIS SCHEMA IS ONLY FOR THE AGENT HALF OF E1. Spec 13/E1 says the agent runs ONLY when no pattern in scripts/type_patterns.py decides, so most real questions never produce a file of this shape at all; scripts/checks/E1.py re-runs that classifier and fails an output whose question whose shape the script could have settled on its own. The `question_type` enum is config/allowed_values.yaml v0.3's list verbatim, 20 values, generated from docs/question_categories/RULEBOOK.md section 1. `note` is optional per Universal rule 7 ('if the input looks wrong ... say so in the note field'), following schemas/D11.json's precedent -- schemas/B7.json omits it, and that inconsistency is reported rather than copied. `codebook_version` is NOT part of this output: spec 13.0 makes recording it the RUNNER's job ('records its file hash as codebook_version on every tag it produced'), and only E4's output carries it because spec 13/E4 names it explicitly in the agent's own output shape.

question_type.description: How the question is BUILT -- structure only. Never what the student must pick (that is E2/format), never the NCERT material (E3), never the thinking (E4). config/allowed_values.yaml question_type, v0.3.

new_description.description: One line, REQUIRED (non-empty) when question_type is new_type -- that is what E_NEW_CATEGORY (normal) carries to Stage F. Otherwise normally empty; codebook/E1.md §2 also uses it to record a legitimate SECOND E1 tag (e.g. 'also figure_to_read') because this output shape holds only one question_type, which is an open question for the owner (codebook/E1.md §5.1). Enforced in scripts/checks/E1.py.

oneOf.description: Universal rule 8: if the input file is missing or broken, the agent writes only {"error": "..."}.
